name: CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities
documentation: The public JSON feed contains a vulnerabilities array. cveID is the event ID, vulnerabilityName is its description, dateAdded is a YYYY-MM-DD date (UTC, date precision), vendorProject and product identify the affected vendor and product. Trim vendor/product strings. Event type is the constant known_exploited_vulnerability; severity must be unknown because the feed provides no CVSS score. There is no authentication and no pagination. The example below is synthetic, not a claim about a real vulnerability.
